ProCam merchant guide: what you do, in order

Only what the merchant needs: an online booking first (scan the customer's QR, hand over, take it back), then a walk-in booking (card, cash or QR), then a battery swap, then checking your income. Customer screens appear only where you scan something from them. Screens are from the app on a phone.

Online booking

A customer who booked and paid on their phone in advance. They show you their booking QR, you scan it, hand over the drone, and take everything back when their time is up.

Walk-in booking

A customer with no booking. They scan the shop's walk-in QR and fill in their order on their own phone, you confirm it, take the payment (card, cash or QR), and then hand over the drone exactly as for an online booking.

Battery swap

A customer on a rental swaps their batteries at your shop. They show their swap QR, you scan it, hand over fresh batteries and take the swap fee.

Check income

What your shop has earned, and how it is worked out.

Screens captured from the local copy of the app with test data. The only difference from the live site is the orange test-only buttons, which don't appear in production.
